messages.author: 6d7ca443df0b7ce3
messages.subject: robustness of the estimated parameter
parts:
Hi, everyone.
First of all, thank you for creating this excellent package for us investigator in decision-making field. I was recently analyzing IGT behavior data and using hBayesDM for computational modeling. I have successfully finished the igt_pvl_decay, igt_pvl_delta, igt_vpp model fitting. What about the robustness of the estimated parameter in these model ?
In most study there are 100 trials in IGT data, however  there are 150 trials in our IGT data. Whether 150 trials would lead the overfitting of the computational models.If it will cause over-fitting, how should we judge whether it is over-fitting.
Looking forward to your reply. Thank you!

messages.author: 9b1ba46046eac99f
messages.subject: Re: robustness of the estimated parameter
parts:
Hi,

I wouldn't imagine over-fitting will happen when you have more trials. In fact, more trials will make model estimation more reliable. 
For robustness, you may want to do a parameter recovery analysis. 

hope that helps,
Lei

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: Re: robustness of the estimated parameter
parts:
Hi,

Sorry for the long delay!

Unfortunately, you can't do parameter recovery right away with hBayesDM. However, you can check parameter recovery performance of those models in these papers:

https://ccs-lab.github.io/papers/haines2018_cogsci/

https://ccs-lab.github.io/papers/ahn2014_frontier/

Best,
Young
